manualFollowUps: Before merging: create the free Pages project schood-admission (Cloudflare API or wrangler pages project create), so the first deploy-pages run can publish it.

Pages: merging publishes schood-admission and rebuilds schood-assessment (worked-solution field in the question editor). Then run the 'Configure Schood Admission Domain' workflow to bind admission.schood.online.
Database: supabase db push --linked from an isolated migrations folder containing only 20261024200000_admission_learner_state.sql. Codex's nine #220 payment migrations stay pending.

Secrets: supabase secrets set ADMISSION_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://admission.schood.online --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel. Later, when the Schood content workspace has approved questions: supabase secrets set ADMISSION_CONTENT_TENANT_ID=<workspace tenant id> and supabase secrets set ADMISSION_ENABLED=true. Until both are set the function answers 503.

Edge: deployment of admission with supabase functions deploy admission --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel, then redeploy assessment-cloud so worked solutions saved in the editor are kept in the private key.
verification: admission.schood.online loads the sign-in page in uz, ru and en.
Without a session GET /functions/v1/admission/state returns 503 not_enabled while the flag is off.
supabase migration list --linked shows 20261024200000 applied; the four learner_subject_* tables have RLS on and no browser grants.
In Assessment Cloud a question saved with a worked solution keeps it after reopening the editor.

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-assessment; schood-admission can be left on its previous deployment or unbound.
rollback.migration: Additive only: four new tables and one function. Leave them in place; nothing else reads them.
rollback.edge: Unset ADMISSION_ENABLED (the function answers 503) or redeploy the previous assessment-cloud version.
